不必先写成简历。从一次作业、活动或练习说起，一句话也可以开始。: You do not need a finished resume. Start with one assignment, activity or practice, even one sentence.
两种方式分别保留草稿，保存当前显示的内容。: Each method keeps its own draft. Save the content currently shown.
你想记录哪类经历？: What kind of experience is this?
选最接近的一类，下面的问题会跟着变化；写过的内容保留。: Choose the closest type. The prompts will change, and your writing will stay.
回忆这件事，先写清楚过程: Recall what happened, one part at a time
实际内容与行动（必填）: What happened and what you did (required)
已有项目说明、工作笔记或简历原文，可以直接粘贴；先保留自己的说法。: Paste an existing project description, work note or resume text. Keep your own wording first.
用“什么事＋做了什么”起名，方便以后找回。: Name the activity and what you did, so you can find it later.
补充本人贡献与关联技能（选填）: Add your contribution and related skill (optional)
团队项目只写自己负责的部分；不确定可以先留空，下一步再核对。: For team projects, describe only your own part. Leave uncertain details blank and check them next.
以下为虚构示例，只参考组织方式，不会填入你的记录。: This fictional example shows structure only. It will not be inserted into your record.
现在没有完整成果，也能记录: You can record work that is still in progress
练习没做完、结论不确定，都可以如实写当前进展。这里先保留事实，之后再整理表达。: Record your current progress honestly, even if the practice is unfinished or the conclusion uncertain. Refine the wording later.
预览将保存的原文: Preview the text to be saved
这里会显示你自己写下的内容。: Your own writing will appear here.
还有内容需要补充，已定位到第一处。写过的内容保留。: Please add the missing information. Focus has moved to the first item. Your writing is preserved.
下一步逐项核对原文。现在保存仍是待确认记录，不代表能力已认证。: Check the original text next. Saving creates a pending record, not verified ability.
草稿自动保留在本机；不上传文件，不调用 AI。: Drafts are kept on this device. No files are uploaded and no AI is called.
请选择这段经历的实际类型。: Choose the actual type of this experience.
先写一句实际内容或自己做过的事，再保存。: Write one sentence about what happened or what you did before saving.
请粘贴或填写实际经历原文，再保存。: Paste or write the actual experience before saving.
请给这件事起一个便于找回的标题。: Give this experience a title you can find later.
这是什么课或作业？当时需要解决什么问题？: Which course or assignment was it? What needed to be done?
你具体做了哪一步？可以从整理、记录、查找或检查说起。: What step did you take? Start with organizing, recording, finding or checking something.
留下了表格、代码、报告，还是一份尚未完成的草稿？: Did you leave a table, code, a report or an unfinished draft?
例如：课程作业中的数据整理: For example: organizing data for an assignment
课程要求整理一份练习表。: The course asked us to organize a practice table.
我标记了空白字段，把处理理由记在表格旁。: I marked blank fields and noted the reasons for handling them next to the table.
留下问题清单；结论还没有重复检查。: I left an issue list. The conclusions have not been checked again.
你为什么想做这件事？想验证或做出什么？: Why did you start? What did you want to test or make?
你实际做了什么尝试？用了什么方法或材料？: What did you actually try? Which methods or materials did you use?
目前留下了什么？哪些还没做完、还不能确定？: What do you have so far? What is unfinished or uncertain?
例如：个人网页的第一次实现: For example: building a first personal webpage
想试着做一个展示作品的网页。: I wanted to try building a webpage to show my work.
我画了页面草图，并实现了导航和作品列表。: I sketched the page and built its navigation and work list.
页面可以打开；手机排版还没检查。: The page opens, but I have not checked the mobile layout.
是哪次活动？你在什么场景下参与？: Which activity was it? How were you involved?
你具体负责哪部分？怎样与别人配合？: Which part did you handle? How did you work with others?
留下了什么记录或交接？活动没结束也可以写当前进展。: What records or handover did you leave? If it is ongoing, describe the current progress.
例如：社团活动的报名整理: For example: organizing sign-ups for a club activity
社团准备一次活动，需要整理报名。: The club was preparing an activity and needed to organize sign-ups.
我汇总了报名表，并把重复信息交给负责人核对。: I combined the sign-up forms and sent duplicate entries to the organizer for checking.
留下报名清单；最终到场情况还未知。: I left a sign-up list. Final attendance is still unknown.
当时有什么任务？只写允许公开的背景。: What was the task? Include only context you are allowed to share.
你实际承担了哪几步？不要把团队的工作都算作自己的。: Which steps did you actually handle? Separate your part from the team's work.
交付了什么、收到什么反馈？没有反馈就如实保留未知。: What did you deliver, and what feedback did you receive? If there was none, keep it unknown.
例如：实习期间的一次资料整理: For example: organizing materials during an internship
团队需要整理一批允许使用的资料。: The team needed to organize materials we were allowed to use.
我按已有规则分类，并记录不确定的条目。: I classified them using existing rules and noted uncertain items.
交接了整理清单；尚未收到反馈。: I handed over the list and have not received feedback yet.
这条记录与什么事情有关？不知道的可以先留空。: What is this record about? Leave unknown details blank for now.
写清实际名称、内容或正在进行的练习，不把计划写成已经完成。: Describe the actual name, content or ongoing practice. Keep plans separate from completed work.
有可核对的材料或日期吗？没有时可以留空。: Do you have a source or date to check? Leave it blank if not.
例如：一次工具练习的记录: For example: a record of practicing a tool
想学习一种新的表格工具。: I wanted to learn a new spreadsheet tool.
我跟着公开教程整理了一份练习表。: I followed a public tutorial to organize a practice table.
保存了练习文件；还没有独立完成新任务。: I saved the practice file and have not completed a new task independently yet.
先写用了什么材料、做了哪一步、留下了什么。还没完成的部分也可以如实记下来。: Start with the materials you used, the step you took and what you produced. Record unfinished work honestly too.
只写自己负责的部分，例如整理资料、实现一段功能或检查结果；参考与协作方式在下方单: Describe your own part, such as organizing materials, building a function or checking a result. Record references and collaboration separately below.
写清发生了什么、对方明确说了什么、哪些仍未确定。没有收到回复时，不必替对方猜测原: Record what happened, what the other person explicitly said and what is still uncertain. If there was no reply, do not guess why.
可以按三句话记录：当时想弄清什么；实际做了哪一步；留下了什么、还有什么没弄清。: Try three sentences: what you wanted to find out; what you actually did; what you left and what remains unclear.
区分自己负责、团队完成和参考辅助的部分；不能确定时先记录事实。: Separate your own part, the team's work and any reference help. Record facts when details are uncertain.
输入草稿已在本机保留；点击“保存，去核对经历”后，再逐项确认。: Your draft is kept on this device. Choose Save and check this experience, then review each item.
把一件小事，写成自己的经历: Turn a small moment into your own experience
不用一口气写完整。先想起一个片段，慢慢把它串起来。: You do not have to write it all at once. Start with a moment and connect the pieces.
选最接近的一类，回忆线索会跟着变化；写过的内容保留。: Choose the closest type. The prompts will adapt, and your writing will stay.
当时有人交给你什么任务，或者你自己想试什么？: What task were you given, or what did you want to try?
回到那门课、那个活动或一次练习，想想事情是怎样开始的。: Think back to that class, activity or practice. How did it begin?
当时最想弄明白的一件事是什么？: What was the one thing you wanted to understand?
你最先打开了什么、整理了什么，或动手试了哪一步？: What did you first open, organize or try?
哪一步让你停下来？你后来查找、调整或检查了什么？: Where did you get stuck? What did you look up, change or check next?
一起做事时，哪一部分由你负责？你怎样交接给别人？: Which part was yours when working together? How did you hand it over?
翻翻文件、笔记或聊天记录，有什么能让你想起这次经历？: Look through files, notes or messages. What brings this experience back?
有人明确给过什么反馈吗？没有收到也可以如实记录。: Did anyone give explicit feedback? It is fine to record that there was none.
哪部分已经尝试过，哪部分还没做完或不能确定？: What have you tried, and what is still unfinished or uncertain?
只参考组织方式，不会填入你的记录。: Use the structure as a reference. This will not be inserted into your record.
经历不必有漂亮的结尾，如实保留进展就好。: Your experience needs no perfect ending. Record the progress honestly.
经历标题（必填）。用“什么事＋做了什么”，方便以后找回。: Experience title (required). Name the event and what you did so you can find it later.
只展示你自己写下的内容。点一段，可以回去继续写。: Only your own words appear here. Choose a part to keep writing.
还没起名字的一件小事: A small moment, yet to be named
想起一个场景，就可以开始。: One scene is enough to begin.
这里会留下你亲自做过的那一步。: The step you took yourself will appear here.
没做完也没关系，可以写当前进展。: Unfinished is fine. Describe where you are now.
本机草稿 · 尚未保存为待确认记录: Local draft · not yet saved for review
粘贴自己的文字后，这里会显示原文。: Paste your own words to see the original text here.
填写经历背景、具体行动和结果，保存后逐项核对。: Enter the context, actions and results, then save and review each item.
根据经历类型显示填写提示，切换类型会保留已填内容。: Prompts match the experience type. Changing the type preserves your entries.
虚构示例，仅供参考，不会填入你的记录。: Fictional example for reference. It will not be inserted into your record.
结果与进展为选填；未完成时可记录当前进展。: Results and progress are optional. For unfinished work, enter your current progress.
预览当前输入，选择任一项可返回编辑。: Preview your entries. Select an item to edit it.
填写项目、活动或工作名称及具体内容，便于查找。: Include the project, activity or work name and details so you can find it later.
请补充必填项，已定位到第一处。已填内容已保留。: Complete the required fields. Focus has moved to the first one. Your entries are preserved.
保存为待确认记录后逐项核对原文，不代表能力已认证。: Save a pending record, then review each item against the original text. This does not verify ability.
当时收到什么任务，或计划解决什么问题？: What task were you given, or what problem did you plan to solve?
这项经历属于哪门课、哪个活动或哪次练习？: Which course, activity or practice was this experience part of?
这项经历需要弄明白或解决什么问题？: What question or problem did this experience address?
你具体执行了哪些步骤，使用了哪些材料或工具？: Which steps did you take, and which materials or tools did you use?
遇到了什么问题？你查找、调整或检查了什么？: What problem did you encounter? What did you research, change or check?
哪一部分由你负责？如何与他人配合、交接？: Which part did you handle? How did you collaborate and hand over your work?
完成了哪些文件、代码、报告或其他产物？: Which files, code, reports or other outputs did you produce?
是否收到具体反馈？记录原话或明确的评价。: Did you receive specific feedback? Record the exact words or explicit assessment.
哪些内容尚未完成，哪些结论仍需核对？: What remains unfinished, and which conclusions still need checking?
请填写实际内容与行动。: Enter the actual content and actions taken.
